transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy exercise or lifting heavy objects for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That helps, thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for clarifying. I'm experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things look brighter than usual, wear sunglasses outside. But if it’s significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity especially with a red, painful eye, that is not normal and may need to be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense, thank you. One more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle over time. If it is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's everything I wanted to ask. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. I appreciate your help!

verdict.label: pass
